summary: Crash on /districts/sync for schools without a district
repro: Create a School with district = None and call resolve_district(); it panics. In production: open /districts/sync as a school still in onboarding.
success_criteria: cargo test passes: schools without a district resolve to "unassigned" instead of panicking; assigned schools keep resolving to their district name.
constraints: Schools may exist without districts during onboarding — this state is valid and must render, not error. Keep the change minimal.
